convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load external PPO_Cloud indicator, depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade execution and money management, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh for smoothing algorithms) which contain custom position sizing and trading logic not replicable from built-in MT5 functions alone.

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds for signal timing
min_rates_total - minimum bars for indicator warmup
UpSignalTime - timestamp for buy signal bar close
DnSignalTime - timestamp for sell signal bar close

other_exits: Opposite signal closes the position: when indicator crosses above signal, existing sell positions are closed; when indicator crosses below signal, existing buy positions are closed. Close signals are gated by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans.

modes: LOSSFREEMARGIN=2: fraction of free margin minus loss
LOSSBALANCE=3: fraction of balance minus loss

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT (default) uses MM as fixed lot size (0.1). Other MarginMode enum values interpret MM as a fraction (0.1 = 10%) of the respective margin base (free margin, balance, loss-adjusted free margin, or loss-adjusted balance). Logic is encapsulated in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a PPO (Percentage Price Oscillator) Cloud custom indicator with configurable smoothing algorithms (SMA, EMA, SMMA, LWMA, JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) via the SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library. Entry logic reads from bars [SignalBar] and [SignalBar+1]: on bar [1] the indicator must be on the correct side of the signal, and on bar [0] (the previous completed bar when SignalBar=1) a crossover must have occurred. The Recount flag forces recalculation on the first tick or after a CopyBuffer failure. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen input booleans gate entry signals; BuyPosClose/SellPosClose gate exit signals. GlobalVariableDel_ is called on deinit to clean up global variables used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management.
python_conversion_notes: The PPO_Cloud indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it is a custom indicator using proprietary smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh. The standard PPO can be computed as: PPO = ((Fast_EMA - Slow_EMA) / Slow_EMA) * 100, then signal line = EMA(PPO, 9). However, the custom smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, etc.) have no direct Python equivalents and would need algorithm-by-algorithm porting. TradeAlgorithms.mqh wraps order sending with position management, money management, and global variable cleanup - this logic must be reimplemented. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so need digit-adjustment awareness when converting (1000 points = 100 pips on 5-digit, 1000 pips on 4-digit). The entry signal reads two consecutive buffer values to detect crossover: Ind[1]>Sign[1] && Ind[0]<=Sign[0] for long (crossover from below on the previous bar pair). SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the last completed bar, not the current forming bar.
